text: You made a sign error when factoring x^2+x-6, leading you to think x+2 was common.
You found the LCM, not the HCF. The HCF is the common factor, not the product of all factors.
You multiplied the common factor from each expression instead of taking it once.
You found the HCF using lowest powers instead of the LCM.
You multiplied the two expressions instead of taking the highest powers for the LCM.
You took the LCM of 6 and 9 but used the lowest powers of a and b.
You used 13% minus 10% on the marked price instead of applying VAT after discount.
You stopped after the discount and did not add the 13% VAT.
You added VAT to the marked price, forgetting the 10% discount first.
You took 25% of the selling price as profit. Profit % is on the cost price, so the SP is 125% of the CP.
You multiplied the selling price by 125%. The SP already includes the profit, so work back to the cost price.
You found only the profit, and took it as 25% of the selling price. Profit % is on the cost price.
You used simple interest. Compound amount includes interest on interest.
You found only the compound interest, not the total amount. Remember to add the principal.
You calculated for 1 year only. Remember to account for the 2 years in the compound amount.
You used simple depreciation. Each year the 20% is taken from the new, lower value.
You used the growth formula (1+R/100) instead of the depreciation formula (1-R/100).
You found only the total depreciation, not the final value after 2 years.
You added the powers 3 and 2 in (x^3)^2. Check the rule for a power of a power, then deal with x^-4.
You added 6+4 instead of using the minus sign for x^-4.
You multiplied all the powers: 3*2*4. Check which index rule fits each part separately.
You made a sign error. (x+2)(x+3) is x^2+5x+6, not x^2-5x+6.
You picked factors of 6 but did not check the sum equals 5.
You read the coefficients 5 and 6 as the roots. The roots are not the coefficients.
You forgot the 1/2. A triangle's area is half of base times height.
You used 13 cm, the longest side, as the height. In a right triangle the two shorter sides are base and height.
You used Heron's formula but forgot to take the square root at the end.
You found the cylinder volume, forgetting the 1/3 factor for the cone.
You used r instead of r^2 in the volume formula. Check the power of the radius.
You used the diameter as the radius in the volume formula.
You found n(T u C)=90, which is those who like at least one, not neither.
You left out the 20 who like both when finding those who like at least one drink.
You counted only those who like one drink, not the total who like tea or coffee.
You forgot the 10 who read neither. First find how many read at least one paper.
You found how many read at least one paper. The overlap is the group counted twice in 50+35.
You found those who read only K, not the number who read both K and G.
You thought all 11 possible sums were equally likely. They are not.
You counted 7 outcomes just because the sum is 7. Write out the dice pairs with sum 7.
You missed that order matters. (1,6) is different from (6,1) when counting outcomes.
You treated the draws as with replacement, which is wrong for this problem.
You calculated P(red then blue) instead of P(both red).
You only found P(red) for the first draw, not P(both red). Remember the second draw changes the total.
You mixed mass and weight. Mass does not change, even if weight on the Moon is 1/6 of Earth's.
You used weight. Weight is a force in Newtons, not mass in kg.
You thought less gravity means no mass. Mass is the amount of matter, and it stays the same on the Moon.
You thought light speeds up in glass. Remember, glass is optically denser than air.
You thought light always moves at 3x10^8 m/s. Remember, glass is optically denser than air.
You thought refraction changes colour. Frequency stays the same; speed and wavelength change.
You thought bubbles must be oxygen, but HCl has no oxygen to give.
You thought the chlorine from HCl is released. It stays in the ZnCl2 salt.
You mixed up zinc with acid + carbonate. Zinc metal has no carbon.
You used atomic number as group number. Group is not the atomic number.
You used the number of shells (3) for the group. Shells tell the period, not the group.
You took the 8 electrons of the second shell, not the outermost shell's one electron.
You thought t was dominant. Remember, T is dominant over t when T is present.
That 3 tall:1 dwarf ratio is for F2, not the F1 plants.
You thought traits blend. T is dominant, so Tt plants are fully tall, not medium.
You thought arteries always carry oxygen-rich blood. The pulmonary artery takes deoxygenated blood to the lungs.
You thought the aorta carried oxygen-rich blood from the lungs. It goes from the heart to the body.
You thought the vein entering the heart was the vena cava. That vein brings deoxygenated blood from the body.
You mixed up global warming with acid rain. SO2 causes acid rain, not the main warming gas.
You mixed global warming with ozone depletion. Ozone depletion is not caused by the gas from burning fuels.
You thought the most plentiful gas causes warming; nitrogen does not trap heat.
The word year made you think it measures time. Think about what light travels in one year.
You thought it is the speed of light. A light year is not a speed; think about what light travels in one year.
The word light made you think it measures how bright a star is. It is used for stars, but not for brightness.
